lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，走得很稳
lines.en: I follow behind you, steady on my feet
Where the master goes, I go

lines.zh: 四只脚踩在你踩过的地方
lines.en: My four feet land where yours have been

lines.zh: 我头上这面盾，你摸过很多次
lines.en: You have touched this frill on my head many times
Slow down a little, I am broad
I go around the flowers in the meadow

lines.zh: 我离你三步远，不会撞上
lines.en: I keep three paces back so I cannot bump you
My tail swings, I am in a good mood
At doorways I have to turn sideways
When your steps stop, mine stop
I walk beside you and block the wind

lines.zh: 角上挂着你给我系的绳
lines.en: The cord you tied is on my horn
The dirt road is easy, the meadow is soft
I go step by step, tight behind

lines.zh: 回头看你一眼，再往前走
lines.en: I glance back at you, then walk on
I lie down beside you and chew slowly
My frill is warm in the sun
I touch my nose to your hand
Do your work, I will wait
My horn base itches, I rub the wood

lines.zh: 我听见有东西在草丛里
lines.en: I hear something in the grass

lines.zh: 地上有我啃出的一小圈
lines.en: There is a little ring cropped where I eat
My breathing is slow, as if dozing

lines.zh: 你的东西放在我背上，我不动
lines.en: Your things sit on my back, I hold still
I do not call out, I would not want to disturb you

lines.zh: 草很甜，我给你留了一半
lines.en: The grass is sweet, I saved you half

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，眼睛贴着头盾
lines.en: I look up at you past my frill

lines.zh: 你摸我的角，我就低下头
lines.en: When you touch my horn, I lower my head
It is safe here, I have smelled it

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾巴，赶走苍蝇
lines.en: I flick my tail to drive off the flies

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我也抬着头
lines.en: You look down at me, and I look up
Your hands still smell of grass
I push my head over to be petted

lines.zh: 你挡在我角前面，我不介意
lines.en: You stand before my horns, and I do not mind
You smell of the wild outside

lines.zh: 你说话的时候，我听不懂也听着
lines.en: When you talk, I listen without understanding

lines.zh: 你走得远了，我会跟上来
lines.en: If you go far, I will catch up

lines.zh: 你在我旁边，我的头盾就不挡你了
lines.en: Beside you, I keep the frill out of your way
Your shadow is at my feet
I look at you more than at the grass
You laugh, perhaps because of me

lines.zh: 我鼻子里喷了口气，是高兴
lines.en: I snort a breath, that is contentment
Untie the cord, I will not run

lines.zh: 你坐在地上，我就趴下来
lines.en: Sit on the ground and I will lie down

lines.zh: 我见过别的角，可只认这一个
lines.en: I have seen other horns, I answer only to this

lines.zh: 你摸我的头盾，我会眯眼
lines.en: When you stroke my frill, my eyes close
When you leave, I leave with you

lines.zh: 你说走，我不明白，可我会动
lines.en: You say go, I do not understand, but I move

lines.zh: 我叫一声，你回头看我就行
lines.en: If I call, just look back at me

lines.zh: 我退了半步，靠到你身边
lines.en: I step back and come to your side
That one I took on the shoulder

lines.zh: 我把伤口偏开，不让你看见
lines.en: I turn the wound away so you will not see
I nudge you, and it is fine
There is a new mark on my frill
I paw the ground and hold
Thick hide does not keep out the ache
With you in front of me, I am not afraid
I grit my teeth, I did not retreat far
Grass in your hand, I remember
I stretch my head over and eat slowly
Whatever you give, I will eat
That handful is not much, but sweet
Do not pull your hand back, my teeth are flat
I eat and keep watching you

lines.zh: 你藏在背后的，我闻到了
lines.en: I smell what you hid behind your back

lines.zh: 再给一点，我就跟着你走
lines.en: A little more and I will follow you anywhere

lines.zh: 你蹲下来喂，我就不用低头那么低
lines.en: Kneel to feed me and I need not stoop so far

lines.zh: 这东西我喜欢，比野草好
lines.en: I like this, better than wild grass
When I finish I will nudge you

lines.zh: 你把草举高，我会站起来
lines.en: Hold the grass high and I rise up

lines.zh: 吃完了，我就在你旁边站着
lines.en: Done eating, I will stand beside you
There is salt on your hand
I take it gently, I will not bite you
This mouthful is saved for you
You feed me, and I do not snatch

lines.zh: 我撞到你，赶紧往边上让
lines.en: I bumped you and quickly shift aside

lines.zh: 我退了一步，怕再挤到你
lines.en: I step back, afraid of crowding you
I turn my horns away, not at you
Leaning on my shoulder is steady

lines.zh: 我身子太宽，走窄路会碰到
lines.en: I am broad, on a narrow path I brush things
That one was me not watching the path
I lower my head, that is an apology

lines.zh: 你别站在我后面，我看不见
lines.en: Do not stand behind me, I cannot see you

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，先看你在哪
lines.en: I turn slowly, checking where you are first
One pat and I hold still
The wild ones run, I do not
You tied the cord on my horn

lines.zh: 你走的时候，我跟在后面
lines.en: When you go, I walk behind
However fine other horns are, I answer none of them
I lie at the door waiting for you to come back

lines.zh: 我不许别人靠近这个院子
lines.en: I let no one near this yard

lines.zh: 你摸我的头盾，我就安静了
lines.en: Stroke my frill and I go quiet

lines.zh: 这种话我听不懂，可我留下
lines.en: I do not understand such words, but I stay

lines.zh: 你走远一点，我跟着就行
lines.en: Walk a bit farther, I will follow

lines.zh: 我在这儿，你回来就能看见
lines.en: I am here, and you will see me when you return
I lower my head and carry it to you

lines.zh: 角上挂着的东西，我甩不下来
lines.en: What is on my horn will not shake off
I carry it carefully
This is hard to hold, here it is
I nudge it to you with my nose

lines.zh: 它掉在我脚边，我踩住了
lines.en: It fell at my feet and I pinned it
I set it down and look up at you

lines.zh: 前面有一个，我给你带过来
lines.en: There is one ahead, I will bring it
My back can carry things

lines.zh: 你把东西放我背上就好
lines.en: Just put it on my back
Something is coming near us

lines.zh: 我往前挪了一步，挡在你前面
lines.en: I shift one step forward, in front of you
I lower my head, horns outward
This is not someone from the yard
I smell something unfamiliar
I called once, to warn you
My frill is raised
Do not go forward, I will
The grass goes silent under my feet

lines.zh: 我背上的东西放下来了
lines.en: The load on my back is set down
I keep myself between it and you
When it moves, I turn with it
I block the way, it cannot pass
Stay behind me, do not show yourself
I press forward a step at a time
I lower my head, pawing, ready
It backs off, and I do not chase far
My horns stay pointed at it
Fall back, I will hold the gate

lines.zh: 它要是再近，我就不客气
lines.en: If it comes closer, I stop being polite
The horns go out and it retreats

lines.zh: 我撞了一下，把你挡在后面
lines.en: I charge once, keeping you behind me
I swing my head and sweep it aside

lines.zh: 前脚落下，土被压出一个坑
lines.en: My forefoot lands and presses out a pit

lines.zh: 它绕过来，我一转身挡住
lines.en: It circles, I turn and block
That charge hurt my shoulder too
Get behind me
It withdrew, and I am still here

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，你听见就知道没事
lines.en: I called once, so you know it is fine

lines.zh: 我站在你旁边，绳还系着
lines.en: I stand beside you, the cord still tied
I come out of the yard
You called and I came
A broad shadow is on the dirt road
I put my head right in front of you
I land lightly
That cord on my horn, you tied it
I sniff around here, it is familiar
I stand at the door waiting for you
In this party, I am at the front
A path is pressed through the grass

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，等我一句话
lines.en: I look up at you, waiting for a word

lines.zh: 火烧到腿，我往你那边靠
lines.en: Fire caught my leg and I pressed toward you

lines.zh: 我摔下去，第一件事是找你
lines.en: I fell, and the first thing I did was look for you
The water is deep, I stretched my head up and called
The blast knocked me back several steps

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我盾上，我挡在你前面
lines.en: An arrow hit my frill, I stood in front of you

lines.zh: 那股劲儿进来，我晃了一下
lines.en: That force entered me and I swayed

lines.zh: 草吃完了，我饿着也不叫
lines.en: The grass is gone, I go hungry without a sound
Lightning struck my horn and my legs buckled

lines.zh: 这里没有地，我抓不住你
lines.en: There is no ground here, I cannot hold on to you
